description: LABELLED SYNTHETIC, source-grounded: the second exec run of one thread (codex exec resume). The thread's first run reported a total of input 1000 (cached 0), output 25. The pinned emitter copies ThreadTokenUsage.total into this run's turn.completed, and the protocol accumulates every response into total_token_usage (TokenUsageInfo::append_last_usage), so 2500 input tokens is the thread's cumulative total; this turn alone used 1500 input tokens, a delta the writer must not compute. A per-turn reading would claim 2500 for this turn with exactly the same numbers.

lines: {"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_0","type":"agent_message","text":"SYNTHETIC: second turn of a resumed thread."}}

counterexamples.why: Would state that this turn used 2500 input tokens; it used 1500. Equal components, different meaning.
A per-turn delta needs the previous run's total; the writer records what the source reported and never computes deltas or cross-run sums.
